errors.message: Maintenance is paused: the maintenance marker is set or a backup is running.
errors.fix: Wait for the backup or the box maintenance to finish; the task retries on its own every 30 minutes.

errors.message: A maintenance run is already in progress.
errors.fix: Wait for it to finish (GET /api/maintenance/status), then run it again if you still need to.
patterns: A maintenance run is already in progress.

errors.fix: Use the step names a dry run (POST /api/maintenance/run with dry_run: true) lists.

errors.message: That retention setting is not valid.
errors.fix: Send setting keys from GET /api/maintenance/retention with values in range (months 1 to 120, time HH:MM).

errors.message: months must be a whole number from 1 to 120.
errors.fix: Send months as null (off) or a whole number from 1 to 120.
patterns: months must be a whole number from 1 to 120.
